need: Make repository history and GitHub release operations verifiable evidence of the same reuse and fail-closed discipline the product promises.

queries: Git coherent commits and annotated tags
GitHub protected default branch hosted checks
discovery.stop_condition: Native Git and GitHub mechanisms cover review boundaries, hosted verification, version identity, artifacts, and provenance without another release service.

contenders.name: coherent Git commits and staged pushes
evidence: pushes expose the exact commit to hosted CI before release

contenders.name: annotated tag and GitHub release
evidence: tag carries version identity and release message
GitHub release binds immutable checksummed assets to the tag

contenders.name: one final squash or rewritten public history
evidence: erases the implementation and refinement evidence chain
unnecessary for a new repository with intentionally scoped commits

contenders.name: tag before hosted gates
evidence: would make the release identity precede its required evidence

hard_gates: commit contains no private planning or runtime state
exact pushed release commit passes required hosted checks
release assets, checksums, SBOM, and attestation are inspected
unknowns: Hosted branch-rule and attestation availability remain unknown until configured and exercised.
decision_effect: Create reviewable implementation and hardening commits, push at hosted-validation boundaries, tag only the verified release commit, and never rewrite released public history.
reconsider_when: GitHub cannot provide a required hosted control
A signed-tag requirement is adopted for a later release
The repository moves to a reviewed pull-request-only contribution model
